blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Bayan Muna Rep. Carlos Isagani Zarate on Wednesday called for a congressional probe into the paper stock losses of the Social Security System (SSS), which is reportedly worth nearly P40 billion. The ex-lawmaker also raised concerns over the pension fund’s risk controls in investments. He said flaws in the SSS’ portfolio risk management and strategy may risk wiping out worker contributions and pose risks to the fund’s solvency. “This is not an abstract accounting matter. These are hard-earned contributions of millions of Filipino workers, pensioners and their families – funds held in trust by the state to […]...
